facts.statement: The new special virtual rewards from the 5M event were one Party Crate, one Silly String can, three Party Poppers, and one Grab Bag.
facts.quote: One Party Crate * One Silly String can * Three Party Poppers * Grab Bag

article_summaries.title: 5 Million Celebration Event - Limited Time Only
article_summaries.summary: SOE's news post announces a limited-time 5M Party Wheel event celebrating the 5,000,000th registered Free Realms player. Players who logged in between September 16 and September 23, 2009 could spin the wheel daily for party-themed virtual rewards. The post's date is inferred from the capture date and its relative 'posted 6 days, 3 hours ago' stamp.
